name: long_text
text: The quarterly compliance review covered several incidents. On 3 February 2024, an employee named Thomas Weber accidentally shared a spreadsheet with an external vendor based in Frankfurt. The file included names such as Julia Schneider and Marco Ferrari, together with their email addresses julia.schneider@example.de and marco.ferrari@example.it. The data protection officer, Anna Kowalski, opened an investigation on 5 February 2024 and reported the breach to the supervisory authority in Berlin within the statutory window.
